review_scope: Declared direct and transitive input hashes

independent_input_audit.reviewer_result: all declared MP0-MP6 inputs and cited evidence matched

findings: MP4's pdev->dev.kobj object description is supported by stock assembly and pinned kernel structure offsets.
MP4 OBS-020 and MP6 OBS-001 correctly map arm64_use_ng_mappings == 0 to 0x0068000000000713 and nonzero to 0x0068000000000f13.
Pinned platform and kernfs source supports partial sysfs group rollback and normal unregister teardown with active callback draining.
No recorded contradictions were found in the reviewed drafts.
open_items: Ownership and release of the OF reference and ofm_iomap/ioremap_prot mappings remain unresolved.
Platform-device registration-error and no-bind paths require L4 analysis; any stale-reference/UAF outcome remains a hypothesis, not a proven runtime result.
Runtime overlay application and the physical meaning of the IMEM word remain unknown.
review_notes: This is a readiness review record. It does not approve a gate, establish semantic equivalence, or authorize candidate source edits.
